prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1333; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the accident you reported. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state the city and state where the accident happened.

A: League City, Texas.

Q: Walk me through what you were doing right before the collision.

A: I was driving on the main road and needed to move into the right lane to make my exit. I checked my mirror, signaled, and started to change lanes.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?

A: I looked, but I didn't see anything beside me at first. Then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car get pushed toward the curb.

Q: Where did the vehicles make contact?

A: Their driver's side hit the passenger side of my car, around the rear door area.

Q: Did you stop after the impact?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder right away and turned on my hazard lights.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt fine at first, but within an hour my neck was stiff and sore. Now I have a constant ache and pain when I turn my head.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care and was told I have a neck strain. I'm scheduled for follow-up visits.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping this gets resolved soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
